messages:
Noah Reed: OmniRetail pinged — asking to consolidate 60 seats from 'trial-team' into 'ops-team', early-renewal request. They want a 13% discount if DocuSign is completed by 2024-12-06 and a prorated credit for unused seats through 2025-07-15. Also asking to switch billing to OmniRetail EU (DE tax id: DE99887766) and Net45. Need finance/legal/onboarding.
Priya Desai: 13% is above our CS approval band. We need PO, signed addendum, and finance confirmation on Net45. Also confirm whether they accept invoice credit vs cash refund for prorate.
Diego Morales: Finance: tentative approval for 13% if they sign a 12mo renewal and provide PO referencing INV-9123. Net45 ok with credit check and AP contact. If PO doesn't reference INV-9123 discount drops to 7%.
Noah Reed: Customer confirmed they will reference INV-9123 and prefer invoice credit (no cash refund). They asked us to include a line that credits apply within 2 billing cycles.
Liam O'Connor: Legal: draft amendment required. I will include prorate formula and settlement language. Suggest clause: "Credit = seat_price * remaining_days / 365; applied as invoice adjustment within 2 billing cycles; execution of amendment constitutes final settlement of seat allocation claims." Will upload redline.
Sophie Tran: Onboarding: seat move needs SSO group remap and CSV of 60 users. Migration window request: 30 mins maintenance; recommend 2024-12-03 02:30 UTC. I'll need CSV by EOD 2024-11-30 to schedule.
Noah Reed: I'll request PO tonight and ask them to sign by 2024-12-05 to give ops time. Liam: please add a short "no further concessions" line so sales won't keep coming back.
Liam O'Connor: Done. Uploaded draft addendum: https://redwood.internal/docs/addenda/omniretail-early-renewal_v1.docx — includes prorate calc and finality language.
billing-bot: Created provisional adjustment ADJ-1759994444-OMN (link: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-1759994444-OMN). Estimated credit = seat_price * remaining_days / 365 * 60.
Diego Morales: Once PO + signed addendum + AP contact received, finance will approve final invoice and apply the credit referencing INV-9123. Also will run credit check for Net45.
Priya Desai: Great. Noah please post PO and user CSV here when you have them. Targeting DocuSign out to renewals@omniretail.com cc:legal@redwood.com. :thumbsup:
